mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parameter_evidence ( decision_id, doc_id, technical_object, parameter_name_raw, parameter_name_canonical, parameter_family, value_raw, comparator, value_min, value_max, unit_raw, unit_normalized, condition_text, evidence_text, page_number, section, source_type, leaf_path, result_form, review_status, first_author_country, title, created_at ) VALUES ( #{decisionId}, #{docId}, #{technicalObject}, #{parameterNameRaw}, #{parameterNameCanonical}, #{parameterFamily}, #{valueRaw}, #{comparator}, #{valueMin}, #{valueMax}, #{unitRaw}, #{unitNormalized}, #{conditionText}, #{evidenceText}, #{pageNumber}, #{section}, #{sourceType}, #{leafPath}, #{resultForm}, #{reviewStatus}, #{firstAuthorCountry}, #{title}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (decision_id) DO UPDATE SET doc_id = EXCLUDED.doc_id, technical_object = EXCLUDED.technical_object, parameter_name_raw = EXCLUDED.parameter_name_raw, parameter_name_canonical = EXCLUDED.parameter_name_canonical, parameter_family = EXCLUDED.parameter_family, value_raw = EXCLUDED.value_raw, comparator = EXCLUDED.comparator, value_min = EXCLUDED.value_min, value_max = EXCLUDED.value_max, unit_raw = EXCLUDED.unit_raw, unit_normalized = EXCLUDED.unit_normalized, condition_text = EXCLUDED.condition_text, evidence_text = EXCLUDED.evidence_text, page_number = EXCLUDED.page_number, section = EXCLUDED.section, source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type, leaf_path = EXCLUDED.leaf_path, result_form = EXCLUDED.result_form, review_status = EXCLUDED.review_status, first_author_country = EXCLUDED.first_author_country, title = EXCLUDED.title
mapper.select: SELECT id, decision_id, doc_id, technical_object, parameter_name_raw, parameter_name_canonical, parameter_family, value_raw, comparator, value_min, value_max, unit_raw, unit_normalized, condition_text, evidence_text, page_number, section, source_type, leaf_path, result_form, review_status, first_author_country, title, publish_year, created_at FROM parameter_evidence WHERE decision_id = #{decisionId}

where.if: AND (technical_object ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR parameter_name_canonical ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR evidence_text ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT id, decision_id, doc_id, technical_object, parameter_name_raw, parameter_name_canonical, parameter_family, value_raw, comparator, value_min, value_max, unit_raw, unit_normalized, condition_text, evidence_text, page_number, section, source_type, leaf_path, result_form, review_status, first_author_country, title, publish_year, created_at FROM parameter_evidence
ORDER BY publish_year DESC NULLS LAST, decision_id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE parameter_evidence pe SET publish_year = p.publish_year FROM paper p WHERE pe.doc_id = p.doc_id AND pe.publish_year IS DISTINCT FROM p.publish_year
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM parameter_evidence WHERE decision_id LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT doc_id AS docId, page_number AS pageNumber FROM parameter_evidence WHERE page_number IS NOT NULL
